title: tephrosia purpurea var. genuina
intro: Tephrosia purpurea var. genuina, commonly known as Purple Tephrosia, is a plant species belonging to the Fabaceae family, native to tropical regions of Asia. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help in treating conditions such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Purple Tephrosia include its ability to act as a demulcent, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant, making it useful in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Purple Tephrosia include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
